project_context.primary_goal: Transform a crammed form into a spacious, step-by-step wizard with a live right-side preview.

layout.wrapper: flex h-screen w-full bg-white overflow-hidden text-gray-900

form_area_center.max_width_constraint: NONE. Remove any max-w-3xl, max-w-2xl, or container classes to eliminate the gap completely.

ats_score_bar.position: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center
ats_score_bar.animation: Slide down on mount, auto-collapse (slide up) after 6 seconds using framer-motion or CSS transition.

quick_fix_card.container: bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl p-5 mb-8 flex items-start gap-4 shadow-sm
quick_fix_card.title: text-amber-900 font-medium text-base
quick_fix_card.action_button: bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 hover:bg-amber-200 px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors

smart_improve_button.style: bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 border border-teal-200 hover:bg-teal-100 h-12 px-6 rounded-lg font-medium flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors shadow-sm

spacing_and_grids.bottom_navigation: mt-12 pt-8 border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-between items-center

image_urls.description: Professional headshot for the resume preview if the user has not uploaded a photo.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install custom fonts via next/font/google in layout.js: 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body.
Completely remove any 'max-w-*' classes on the form container. The center form area must strictly use 'flex-1' to span the entire horizontal gap between the left sidebar and the right preview.
Refactor the single-page form into a step-by-step state machine component mapping (e.g., Personal, Experience, Education, Skills, Extras) showing one form block at a time.
Implement the left sidebar with a state-driven collapsible toggle. When collapsed (w-[56px]), conditionally hide text labels and display centered icons only.
Ensure the right preview panel has a fixed width of 420px on desktop and remains always visible. Use 'shrink-0' so it does not collapse.
Override default Shadcn input sizes with the custom h-14, text-base generous padding styles defined in these guidelines.
Add the ATS score bar at the top of the viewport. It should auto-hide after 6 seconds using a standard useEffect timeout combined with framer-motion's AnimatePresence for smooth slide up.
Render Quick fix cards natively inline, directly above the form fields when active.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'next-step-btn', 'sidebar-nav-item', 'input-first-name').
